title: Reid Electric Service, Inc
description: About Reid Electric Service, Inc At Reid Electric Service, Inc. we realize the safety, and reliability of your electrical system is important to you. We take pride in exceeding your expectations to perform work on your electrical system on time, safely and on budget. Reid Electric Service, Inc has suffered a cyberattack on its service systems, resulting in the theft of approximately 50 GB of sensitive data. The breached information includes employees' personal data and detailed architectural plans of clients' buildings.
